plants.features: Broad, leathery oval leaflets in pairs without a terminal leaflet; long flattened brown pods.

references.label: University of Almería · carob morphology

plants.features: Opposite, simple narrow leaves with a pale silvery underside; small olive drupes, dark when ripe.

references.label: University of Porto · wild olive morphology
Jardins de València · wild and cultivated olive

plants.features: Pinnate leaves with paired leathery leaflets, a winged central stalk and no terminal leaflet; small red drupes turn dark at maturity.

references.label: University of Almería · paired leaflets and winged rachis
University of Málaga Botanic Garden · lentisk

plants.features: Alternate, simple leathery oval leaves with small marginal teeth; small round drupes darken at maturity. This entry represents the poster’s R. alaternus, not R. lycioides.

references.label: University of València Botanic Garden · Rhamnus alaternus

plants.features: Low, clumping palm with folded fan-shaped leaves divided into narrow segments; stiff spines along the leaf stalks.

references.label: Autonomous University of Madrid · dwarf fan palm herbarium sheet
CREAF / Autonomous University of Barcelona · dwarf fan palm

plants.features: Slender, flexible grey-green shoots, losing their small leaves early; small yellow pea flowers in short lateral clusters. Yellow-flowered R. sphaerocarpa, rather than white-flowered R. monosperma.

references.label: University of Almería · Retama sphaerocarpa morphology
Autonomous University of Madrid · Retama herbarium sheet

plants.features: Also known as Stipa tenacissima. Dense basal tussock of long, tough rolled leaves. Shown without flowers; flowering plants have slender stems with narrow panicles and awned spikelets.

references.label: University of Almería · esparto morphology

plants.features: Small woody stems with tiny opposite, narrow rolled-margin leaves; compact terminal heads of pink, two-lipped flowers. The poster specifies winter thyme.

references.label: University of Almería · winter thyme

plants.features: Also called Rosmarinus officinalis. Opposite narrow leaves have rolled-under edges, dark green upper surfaces and whitish undersides. Small pale blue-lavender, two-lipped flowers sit near the stems; this is rosemary, not lavender.

references.label: Autonomous University of Madrid · rosemary herbarium sheet and synonym

plants.features: Grey-brown woody branches end in thorns. Small narrow leathery leaves have entire margins, with little visible lateral venation; small globose drupes turn black. This is the poster’s R. lycioides, distinct from the broader-leaved R. alaternus (Aladierno) already listed.

references.label: University of Málaga Botanic Garden · Rhamnus lycioides

plants.features: Dense, slender green jointed stems with tiny scale-like leaves at the nodes and older grey woody branches. The depicted female sprig bears small red fleshy seed-cone bracts; these are not ordinary fruits or flowers. Male and female structures occur on separate plants.

references.label: University of Almería · Ephedra fragilis morphology

plants.features: Zigzag thorny shoots; alternate small oval leaves with three strong veins from the base and a finely scalloped margin; small drupes. This is wild Z. lotus, not cultivated Z. jujuba.

references.label: Autonomous University of Madrid · Ziziphus lotus herbarium sheet
University of Málaga Botanic Garden · Ziziphus lotus

plants.features: Tortuous thorny branches, small fleshy grey-green leaves and violet tubular flowers with a flared mouth. The illustration represents the poster’s Mediterranean boxthorn.

references.label: University of the Balearic Islands · Lycium intricatum

plants.features: Pale woody branches with very slender, curved, cylindrical grey-green leaves, alternate or in small axillary tufts. Shown in non-flowering foliage state, without broad flat blades. The poster uses the name Salsola webbii.

references.label: Flora de Almería · Salsola webbii diagnosis, p. 108

plants.features: Long leathery lanceolate leaves, opposite or in whorls, with a strong midrib; terminal clusters of simple five-lobed pink flowers.

references.label: University of Barcelona · oleander morphology

plants.features: Fine branching twigs with tiny overlapping scale leaves and slender racemes of minute pink flowers. Genus-level representation: the poster does not identify a Tamarix species. The linked T. gallica describes an example, not the confirmed planting identity.

references.label: University of València Botanic Garden · Tamarix example
